bounded_conclusions: The linear surrogate needs no direction-specific transfer law for upward versus downward exchange.
Negative fixed-plane exchange is sufficient to represent MODFLOW-to-SWAP capillary supply in the interface ledger.
Bidirectionality adds no persistent physical state to the qualified linear surrogate.
The root zone remains internal to SWAP; capillary supply reaches it through the lower SWAP state rather than by direct root-to-MODFLOW coupling.
Internal E_v cancels from total SWAP mass in either direction; E_c cancels only in the complete SWAP plus MODFLOW ledger.
